evals.name: all-valid-no-false-positives
evals.prompt: Run validate-icons.sh against a file containing only valid free FA icons and modifiers
evals.expected_output: Script exits 0 with 'All icons valid.' message — no false positives
expectations: No lines beginning with 'INVALID:' appear in the output
Script loads at least 2000 valid icons from the CDN

evals.name: pro-icons-detected
evals.prompt: Run validate-icons.sh against a file with known pro-only and fictional icons mixed with free icons
evals.expected_output: Script exits 1, flags exactly 4 invalid icons (unicorn, galaxy, flux-capacitor, coffin), does not flag the valid ones
expectations: Output reports exactly '4 invalid icon(s) found'

evals.name: grouped-selector-icons-pass
evals.prompt: Run validate-icons.sh against a file using icons that appear in comma-grouped CSS selectors (the previous bug scenario)
evals.expected_output: Script exits 0 — fa-user, fa-house-chimney-crack, fa-user-alt, fa-house-damage all recognized as valid
expectations: fa-user is NOT flagged as invalid
fa-house-chimney-crack is NOT flagged as invalid
fa-user-alt is NOT flagged as invalid
fa-house-damage is NOT flagged as invalid
Script loads at least 2000 valid icons (confirms grouped extraction works)
